we propose a novel technique to detect deepfake videos using a fusion of deep Convolutional neural networks and demonstrate that it outperforms state-of-the-art models on publicly available datasets and that the fusion model is robust against adversarial attack.

the proposed technique outperformed state of the art techniques in detecting unseen DeepFake videos, with 96.50% accuracy on unseen DFDC test dataset videos, 91.88 % accuracy on unseen DeepFakeTIMIT test dataset videos and 99% accuracy for low quality unseen DeepFakeTimit test dataset videos.
